# CodexScientist Baseline

Use when: baseline resources or metric contracts must be validated.
Do not use when: only a review verdict is needed.
Required context: research manifest and baseline entries.

## Runtime Steps

1. Validate manifest.
2. Confirm or waive baseline gate.

## Verification

Run manifest and baseline checks.
